metadata.description:
With his buck-toothed grin and maroon-and-gold pride, Goldy Gopher is more than a mascot—he’s the spirit animal of the University of Minnesota. Whether he's doing push-ups at football games or striking a pose on campus, Goldy brings mischief and energy wherever he goes. Snap a selfie if you see his statue—it’s tradition! This Minneapolis Marvel POAP is for spotting the furriest legend in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Minneapolis Marvel 
GPS: 44.97307, -93.23486 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.97307,-93.23486 
Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goldy_Gopher
